toeic.title: 사진 묘사의 기본 표현
guide: 위치는 next to, behind, on으로 설명해요.
이 챕터는 사진 묘사에 쓰는 표현 연습입니다.

toeic.title: 질문과 응답
guide: 제안에는 수락이나 거절로 답할 수 있어요.

toeic.title: 짧은 대화의 핵심
guide: but, instead, how about 뒤의 변화를 들어요.

toeic.title: 안내 방송 듣기
guide: Please 뒤에는 요청 행동이 나오는 경우가 많아요.

toeic.title: 문장 빈칸과 문법
guide: 명사 앞에는 형용사가 올 수 있어요.
전치사 뒤에는 명사나 동명사 형태가 와요.

toeic.title: 단일 문서 읽기
guide: 질문에서 찾을 정보가 무엇인지 먼저 확인해요.
질문의 표현이 본문에서 다른 말로 바뀔 수 있어요.

toeic.title: 두 문서 연결하기
toeic.goal: 예약·주문 정보와 후속 안내를 함께 읽어요.
guide: 두 번째 문서에서 바뀐 조건을 확인해요.
한 문서만 읽고 성급하게 답하지 마세요.

tos.title: 의견의 뼈대
guide: I prefer나 I think로 입장을 밝혀요.

tos.title: 의견 확장과 정리
tos.goal: 두 가지 이유와 경험을 묶어 말해요.
guide: 입장 → 첫 이유 → 두 번째 이유 순서로 말해요.

opic.title: 자기소개
guide: 예시를 그대로 외우기보다 나에게 맞게 바꿔요.

opic.title: 집과 동네 묘사
guide: 좋아하는 장소 한 곳을 자세히 설명해요.

opic.title: 일상과 습관
guide: first, then, after that으로 순서를 연결해요.

opic.title: 여행과 과거 경험
opic.goal: 시간 순서로 한 가지 사건을 이야기해요.

opic.title: 과거와 현재 비교
guide: used to, now 같은 표현을 써요.

opic.title: 질문하는 역할극
opic.goal: 상황에 맞는 질문을 여러 개 만들어요.

toeic.title: 진행 중인 동작
toeic.text: A worker is carrying a box.
toeic.why: is carrying는 지금 상자를 나르고 있다는 뜻이에요.

toeic.title: 위치 표현
toeic.text: Several books are on a shelf next to the window.
toeic.why: on a shelf는 선반 위, next to the window는 창문 옆이라는 뜻이에요.

toeic.title: 동작 구분
toeic.text: A woman is arranging chairs in a meeting room.
toeic.why: arrange chairs는 의자를 정리하거나 배치한다는 표현이에요.

toeic.title: 장소를 묻는 질문
toeic.text: Where can I pick up my visitor pass?
toeic.why: Where에 대한 응답으로 장소인 front desk(안내 데스크)가 적절해요.

toeic.title: 변경된 배송일
toeic.text: A: Your order will arrive on Tuesday. B: Our office is closed then. A: We can deliver it on Wednesday instead. B: That is fine.
toeic.why: Tuesday는 원래 계획이고 Wednesday가 최종 합의된 날짜예요.

toeic.title: 다음 행동
toeic.text: A: The printer has stopped working. B: I will call the repair service. A: Thanks. We need the reports by three.
toeic.why: I will call …에서 B가 하겠다고 말한 행동을 확인해요.

toeic.title: 탑승구 변경
toeic.text: Attention, passengers on Flight 205 to Seoul. Your flight will depart from Gate 12, not Gate 8. Please proceed to Gate 12.
toeic.why: not Gate 8과 변경 안내를 구분하고 최종 탑승구 12를 선택해요.

toeic.title: 매장 안내
toeic.text: Our store will close in fifteen minutes. Please take your items to the checkout counter. Thank you for shopping with us.
toeic.why: close in fifteen minutes와 계산대로 이동하라는 요청이 마감 안내임을 알려줘요.

toeic.title: 방문자 안내
toeic.text: Welcome to the museum. The special exhibition is on the second floor. Please leave large bags in the lockers near the entrance.
toeic.why: leave large bags in the lockers가 직접적인 보관 장소 안내예요.

toeic.title: 형용사 자리
toeic.text: The new system is more ___ than the old one.
toeic.why: be동사 뒤에서 시스템의 성질을 설명하고 more와 비교하는 형용사 efficient가 필요해요.

toeic.title: 대조 연결어
toeic.text: We planned to hold the workshop outdoors. ___, heavy rain is expected, so it will take place in Room 3.
toeic.why: 야외 계획과 실내 변경이라는 대조 관계이므로 However가 알맞아요.

toeic.title: 이메일 시제
toeic.text: Dear Ms. Park, Thank you for your payment. We ___ your reservation yesterday. You will receive the tickets tomorrow.
toeic.why: yesterday가 과거의 일을 나타내므로 confirmed가 필요해요.

toeic.title: 첨부 안내
toeic.text: Please review the attached agenda before Friday. ___ We will discuss your suggestions at the meeting.
options: Send any comments by Thursday afternoon.
toeic.why: 의견을 보내 달라는 문장이 다음 문장의 suggestions와 자연스럽게 이어져요.

toeic.title: 등록 마감
toeic.text: Workshop Notice: The writing workshop will be held on June 18. Registration closes on June 10. The fee is $20 and includes lunch.
toeic.why: 행사 날짜 June 18과 등록 마감 June 10을 구분해요.

toeic.title: 이메일 요청
toeic.text: To: All staff. Please submit your travel receipts to the accounting team by Monday. Include your name and department on each receipt.
toeic.why: submit your travel receipts가 요청된 제출 서류예요. receipt는 영수증입니다.

toeic.title: 주문과 배송 메일
toeic.text: Order: Desk lamp, delivery May 4. Email: Due to a supply delay, your lamp will arrive two days later than originally planned.
toeic.why: 원래 날짜 May 4에서 이틀 뒤이므로 May 6이에요.

toeic.title: 광고와 예약
toeic.text: Advertisement: Stay two nights and receive free breakfast. Booking: Ms. Han reserved a room for Friday and Saturday nights.
toeic.why: 금요일과 토요일의 2박 예약이 광고의 free breakfast 조건을 충족해요.

toeic.title: 영수증과 환불 규정
toeic.text: Receipt: Shoes purchased on April 3. Policy: Unused items may be returned within 14 days with a receipt. Customer: The shoes are unused. I would like to return them on April 10.
options: The customer needs to wait longer.
The unused shoes can be returned with the receipt.
Only used shoes can be returned.
toeic.why: 사용하지 않았고 구매 후 14일 이내이며 영수증이 있으면 반품 조건에 맞아요.

tos.title: 매장 안내 읽기
tos.prompt: Read this announcement aloud: Our store opens at ten. Please use the main entrance. Our staff will be happy to help you.
tos.model: Our store opens at ten. Please use the main entrance. Our staff will be happy to help you.
tos.tip: 문장 세 개를 끊어 읽고 ten과 main entrance를 강조해요.

tos.title: 행사 안내 읽기
tos.prompt: Read this message aloud: Thank you for joining our workshop. The first session begins at two thirty. Please bring a notebook.
tos.model: Thank you for joining our workshop. The first session begins at two thirty. Please bring a notebook.
tos.tip: two thirty를 한 덩어리로 읽고 마지막 문장은 공손하게 전달해요.

tos.title: 공원 장면 설명
tos.prompt: Imagine a park. A man is walking a dog. Two children are playing near a tree. Describe the scene.
tos.ko: 공원에서 남자는 개를 산책시키고 아이 두 명은 나무 근처에서 놀고 있어요.
tos.model: This is a park. A man is walking a dog. Two children are playing near a tree. The park looks peaceful.
tos.tip: 보이는 사실을 먼저 말하고 분위기는 마지막에 더해요.

tos.title: 사무실 장면 설명
tos.prompt: Imagine an office. Three people are looking at a laptop. There are notebooks on the table. Describe the scene.
tos.ko: 세 사람이 노트북을 보고 있는 사무실 장면을 설명해보세요.
tos.model: This is an office. Three people are looking at a laptop. There are notebooks on the table. They seem to be discussing something.
tos.tip: 사람의 행동은 are looking, 사물의 존재는 there are로 표현해요.

tos.title: 이동 수단
tos.prompt: How do you usually get to work or school, and why?
tos.ko: 직장이나 학교에 어떻게 가며 왜 그 방법을 이용하나요?
tos.model: I usually take the bus to work. The bus stop is near my home. It is convenient and affordable.
tos.tip: 방법 → 관련 정보 → 이유 순서로 답해요.

tos.title: 음악 듣기
tos.prompt: How often do you listen to music, and when do you usually listen to it?
tos.ko: 음악을 얼마나 자주, 주로 언제 듣나요?
tos.model: I listen to music every day. I usually listen to it on the bus. It makes my trip more enjoyable.
tos.tip: every day와 on the bus로 빈도와 상황을 구체화해요.

tos.title: 교육 일정 안내
tos.prompt: Schedule: Safety training — Tuesday, 10 a.m., Room 2. Team lunch — Tuesday, noon, Café Green. Where and when is the safety training?
tos.model: The safety training is on Tuesday at ten a.m. It will be held in Room 2.
tos.tip: 질문이 묻는 안전 교육 항목만 정확히 전달해요.

tos.title: 운영 시간 안내
tos.prompt: Hours: Monday to Friday, 9 a.m. to 6 p.m.; Saturday, 10 a.m. to 2 p.m.; Sunday, closed. Is the center open on Sunday?
tos.ko: 운영 시간표를 보고 일요일에 여는지 답해보세요.
tos.model: No, the center is closed on Sunday. You can visit on Saturday from ten a.m. to two p.m.
tos.tip: 먼저 No로 답하고 이용 가능한 대안을 덧붙여요.

tos.title: 종이책과 전자책
tos.prompt: Do you prefer paper books or e-books? Give a reason and an example.
tos.ko: 종이책과 전자책 중 선호하는 쪽을 이유와 함께 말해보세요.
tos.model: I prefer e-books because they are easy to carry. For example, I can read several books on my phone when I travel.
tos.tip: 어느 쪽을 골라도 괜찮아요. 선택과 이유가 연결되게 말해요.

tos.title: 집과 식당
tos.prompt: Do you prefer eating at home or at a restaurant? Explain your choice.
tos.ko: 집에서 먹는 것과 외식 중 선호하는 것을 설명해보세요.
tos.model: I prefer eating at home. I can choose fresh ingredients and save money. For example, I often cook simple pasta after work.
tos.tip: 이유를 두 개로 나누어도 문장은 짧게 유지해요.

tos.title: 팀 활동의 장점
tos.prompt: Do you think team activities are useful for students? Explain with reasons.
tos.ko: 학생들에게 팀 활동이 유용한지 이유와 함께 말해보세요.
tos.model: I think team activities are useful. First, students can share different ideas. Second, they learn to communicate. For example, I learned a lot from a group project at school. That is why I support team activities.
tos.tip: 이유 두 개와 개인 경험을 연결하고 같은 단어를 지나치게 반복하지 않아요.

tos.title: 새 기술 배우기
tos.prompt: Is it important for adults to learn new skills? Give reasons and an example.
tos.ko: 성인이 새로운 기술을 배우는 것이 중요한지 말해보세요.
tos.model: I think it is important. New skills can help people at work. They can also make daily life more interesting. For example, I learned basic cooking and now I enjoy making dinner. Learning new skills gives people more choices.

opic.title: 나의 하루 소개
opic.prompt: Tell me about your typical day. What do you do in the morning and evening?
opic.model: I usually get up at seven. I have breakfast and go to work. In the evening, I take a short walk and read a book. It is a simple routine, but I enjoy it.
opic.tip: 시간 순서대로 말하고 마지막에 느낌을 덧붙여요.

opic.title: 관심사 소개
opic.prompt: What are you interested in these days? Explain why you like it.
opic.ko: 요즘 관심 있는 일과 좋아하는 이유를 말해보세요.
opic.model: These days, I am interested in cooking. I started with simple dishes. I like it because I can make healthy meals. Last weekend, I made soup for my family.
opic.tip: 요즘 관심 → 시작 계기 → 이유나 예시를 연결해요.

opic.title: 우리 동네
opic.prompt: Describe your neighborhood. What do you like about it?
opic.model: My neighborhood is quiet and convenient. There is a small park near my apartment. I often walk there after dinner. I like the area because it feels relaxing.
opic.tip: 분위기 → 주변 시설 → 나의 활동 → 이유 순서로 말해요.

opic.title: 좋아하는 카페
opic.prompt: Describe a café you like to visit. What does it look like?
opic.model: There is a small café near my home. It has wooden tables and large windows. The music is soft, and the staff are friendly. I usually read there on Saturday mornings.

opic.title: 운동 습관
opic.prompt: How do you usually exercise? Tell me about your routine.
opic.model: I usually walk three times a week. First, I stretch at home. Then I walk around the park for thirty minutes. After that, I drink water and rest. I feel refreshed afterwards.
opic.tip: 활동과 빈도를 먼저 말하고 순서를 설명해요.

opic.title: 장보기
opic.prompt: Tell me how you usually go grocery shopping.
opic.model: I go grocery shopping on Sundays. Before I leave, I make a short list. I buy vegetables, fruit, and milk at a nearby store. I try not to buy things I do not need.
opic.tip: 준비 → 장소 → 구매 품목 → 나만의 습관을 더해요.

opic.title: 음악 취향
opic.prompt: What kind of music do you like? When do you listen to it?
opic.ko: 좋아하는 음악과 주로 듣는 때를 말해보세요.
opic.model: I like calm pop music. I usually listen to it when I take the bus. The songs help me relax. Recently, I found a new singer and listened to the album several times.
opic.tip: 취향을 말한 뒤 최근 경험을 하나 더해요.

opic.title: 기억에 남는 영화
opic.prompt: Tell me about a movie you enjoyed recently.
opic.ko: 최근 재미있게 본 영화에 대해 말해보세요.
opic.model: I watched a comedy with my friend last month. The story was about two neighbors who became friends. Some scenes were very funny. I liked it because it made me feel happy.
opic.tip: 줄거리는 짧게, 기억에 남는 점과 이유를 더 길게 말해요.

opic.title: 취미를 시작한 계기
opic.prompt: How did you become interested in your favorite hobby?
opic.model: I became interested in photography two years ago. My friend showed me some beautiful pictures. I started taking photos with my phone. Now I take pictures whenever I visit a new place.

opic.title: 예상 밖의 여행
opic.prompt: Tell me about an unexpected event during a trip.
opic.ko: 여행 중 예상하지 못했던 일을 이야기해보세요.
opic.model: Last spring, I visited Jeju with my friend. It rained heavily on our second day. We changed our plan and visited a small museum. It was more interesting than we expected. The rainy day became a good memory.
opic.tip: 예상 밖의 사건 뒤에 대처와 결과를 이어서 말해요.

opic.title: 처음 가 본 곳
opic.prompt: Tell me about the first time you visited a new city.
opic.ko: 새 도시를 처음 방문했던 경험을 말해보세요.
opic.model: I first visited Seoul when I was a student. I took the train with my cousin. The subway system looked confusing at first, but a kind person helped us. We visited a palace and ate delicious food. I felt excited all day.
opic.tip: 장소 설명보다 실제 있었던 사건에 집중해요.

opic.title: 동네의 변화
opic.prompt: How has your neighborhood changed over the years?
opic.model: My neighborhood used to have many small shops. Now there are more cafés and apartment buildings. It is more convenient, but it is also busier. I still like the small park because it has not changed much.
opic.tip: 좋아진 점과 아쉬운 점을 함께 말해도 좋아요.

opic.title: 쇼핑 방식의 변화
opic.prompt: How has the way you shop changed since you were younger?
opic.ko: 예전과 지금의 쇼핑 방식은 어떻게 다른가요?
opic.model: When I was younger, I usually went to stores with my family. Now I often shop online. It saves time, and I can compare prices easily. However, I still visit stores when I buy shoes.
opic.tip: 전체 변화 뒤에 예외 한 가지를 더하면 자연스러워요.

opic.title: 체육관에 문의하기
opic.prompt: You want to join a gym. Call and ask three questions about membership.
opic.ko: 체육관 등록에 대해 세 가지 질문을 해보세요.
opic.model: Hello. I am interested in joining your gym. How much is a monthly membership? What time do you open? Are group classes included? Thank you.
opic.tip: 한 질문에 여러 정보를 섞지 말고 세 가지로 나누어요.

opic.title: 친구와 공연 계획
opic.prompt: You want to go to a concert with a friend. Ask your friend three questions to make a plan.
opic.ko: 친구와 공연에 가려고 해요. 계획을 정할 질문 세 개를 해보세요.
opic.model: Hi. Would you like to go to a concert with me? Which day works for you? What kind of music would you like to hear? How much can we spend on tickets? Let me know.

opic.title: 약속 변경 부탁
opic.prompt: You cannot meet your friend tomorrow. Explain the problem and suggest two alternatives.
opic.ko: 내일 친구를 만날 수 없어요. 이유를 설명하고 대안 두 가지를 제안해보세요.
opic.model: Hi. I am sorry, but I have to work late tomorrow. Could we meet on Saturday instead? If you are busy, we could have a video call on Sunday. Which option is better for you?
opic.tip: 이유는 간단히 말하고 서로 다른 대안 두 개를 제시해요.

opic.title: 잘못 받은 물건
opic.prompt: You ordered a blue bag, but received a black one. Call the store and ask for a solution.
opic.ko: 주문과 다른 색의 가방을 받았어요. 상점에 해결을 요청해보세요.
opic.model: Hello. I ordered a blue bag, but I received a black one today. Could you send me the blue bag? If it is not available, I would like a refund. Please tell me how to return this one.
opic.tip: 문제 → 교환 요청 → 대안 → 반품 절차 질문으로 구성해요.

opic.title: 여행 문제 해결 경험
opic.prompt: Tell me about a time you solved a problem while traveling.
opic.ko: 여행 중 문제를 해결했던 경험을 이야기해보세요.
opic.model: Last year, I missed a bus during a trip. I was worried because I did not know the area. I checked the next bus time and asked a staff member for help. I arrived later than planned, but everything worked out.
